cards.ex: Let's circle back on this next week after we've had time to think.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu haqda o'ylab ko'rishga vaqtimiz bo'lgandan keyin, kelasi hafta yana gaplashamiz.
cards.uzDef: Keyinroq biror narsa haqida yana gaplashish yoki muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: Ping me when you're free to chat.
cards.exUz: Gaplashishga vaqting bo'lganda menga xabar yubor.
cards.uzDef: Menga tezkor xabar yubor, aloqaga chiq.

cards.ex: Here's some food for thought: should we rethink our marketing strategy?
cards.exUz: Mana, o'ylash uchun mavzu: marketing strategiyamizni qayta ko'rib chiqishimiz kerakmi?

cards.ex: Run the proposal by me before you send it to the client.
cards.exUz: Taqdimotni mijozga yuborishdan oldin menga ko'rsating.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani menga tushuntirib ber, ko'rsat.

cards.ex: Let's touch base offline to discuss the details.
cards.exUz: Keling, tafsilotlarni muhokama qilish uchun shaxsiy uchrashuvda gaplashamiz.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy uchrashuvda yoki telefon orqali gaplashish.

cards.ex: Please cc Sarah on all email correspondence regarding this project.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, ushbu loyiha bo'yicha barcha elektron xatlarda Sarahni kopiya qiling.

cards.ex: Per our previous email, the deadline is next Friday.
cards.exUz: Oldingi xatga ko'ra, oxirgi muddat kelasi juma.

cards.ex: Please keep me in the loop about the progress of the project.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, loyihaning rivoji haqida meni xabardor qilib turing.
cards.uzDef: Meni xabardor qilib turing, voqealardan boxabar qiling.

cards.ex: I'll revert back to you as soon as I have more information.
cards.exUz: Qo'shimcha ma'lumotga ega bo'lishim bilan sizga javob qaytaraman.

cards.ex: Thanks in advance for your help with this matter.
cards.exUz: Ushbu masalada yordamingiz uchun oldindan rahmat.
cards.uzDef: Kelgusida qilinadigan yordam uchun oldindan minnatdorchilik bildirish.

cards.ex: We need to do our due diligence before investing in this company.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritishdan oldin tekshiruv o'tkazishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezkor qaror qabul qilishdan oldin tekshirish.

cards.ex: Just to clarify, the meeting is scheduled for next Tuesday.
cards.exUz: Aniqroq bo'lishi uchun, uchrashuv kelasi seshanba kuniga rejalashtirilgan.

cards.ex: I'm attaching the document for your reference.
cards.exUz: Hujjatni ma'lumot olish uchun ilova qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot olish uchun taqdim etiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: "Sorry I'm late." "No worries, we just started."
cards.exUz: "Kech qolganim uchun uzr." "Xavotir olmang, biz endi boshladik."

cards.ex: At the end of the day, we need to make a profit.
cards.exUz: Oxir oqibat, biz foyda ko'rishimiz kerak.
cards.term: At the end of the day

cards.ex: Let's make sure we're all on the same page before we start.
cards.exUz: Ishni boshlashdan oldin hammamiz bir fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrga ega bo'lish, kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: Give me a heads-up if you're going to be late.
cards.exUz: Agar kechikadigan bo'lsangiz, menga ogohlantirib qo'ying.

cards.ex: Let's touch base again next week to discuss the results.
cards.exUz: Natijalarni muhokama qilish uchun kelasi hafta yana aloqaga chiqaylik.

cards.ex: Forwarding this to John, as he's the expert on this topic.
cards.exUz: Buni John ga yuboryapman, chunki u bu mavzu bo'yicha mutaxassis.

cards.ex: As a follow-up to our meeting, I'm sending you the minutes.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvimizning davomi sifatida sizga bayonnomani yuboryapman.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi xat yoki uchrashuvning davomi sifatida.

cards.ex: To recap, we agreed on three main points.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha takrorlash uchun, biz uchta asosiy nuqtaga kelishib oldik.

cards.ex: Please advise on the best course of action.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, eng yaxshi harakat yo'nalishi bo'yicha maslahat bering.

cards.ex: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the meeting has been canceled.
cards.exUz: Kutilmagan sharoitlarga ko'ra, uchrashuv bekor qilindi.

cards.ex: "Thanks for your help!" "Don't mention it!"
cards.exUz: "Yordamingiz uchun rahmat!" "Arzimaydi!"

cards.ex: This is for informational purposes only.
cards.exUz: Bu faqat ma'lumot olish uchun.

cards.ex: I hope this helps clarify the situation.
cards.exUz: Umid qilaman, bu vaziyatni aniqlashtirishga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: On a separate note, have you finished the report?
cards.exUz: Boshqa mavzuga o'tsak, hisobotni tugatdingizmi?

cards.ex: The schedule is subject to change.
cards.exUz: Jadval o'zgarishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Please find attached the contract for your review.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, tekshirish uchun shartnomani ilovada topasiz.

cards.ex: Any input is welcome to improve the project.
cards.exUz: Loyihani yaxshilash uchun har qanday fikr qabul qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday fikr yoki taklif qabul qilinadi.
